enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap to hands. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Open bathroom door. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator door. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Take out butter. Close refrigerator door. Place items on counter. Open cabinet door. Take out frying pan. Close cabinet door. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Melt butter in pan. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs with spatula. Turn off stove. Slide eggs onto plate. Open drawer. Take out fork. Close drawer. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Eat eggs with fork. Drink milk. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Open dishwasher. Place plate inside. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and gathering belongings for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet door. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet door. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Put on belt. Pick up bag. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Close bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music on phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Greet security guard. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Check emails. Attend team meeting. Discuss program plans. Make phone calls to community partners. Write grant proposal. Edit documents. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Organize files. Meet with supervisor. Update program schedule. Send emails. Turn off computer. Pack bag. Leave office.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card on reader. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music on phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Close cabinet. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Open drawer. Take out pan. Close drawer. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Slide food onto plate. Open drawer. Take out fork. Close drawer. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe counter. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open web browser. Check social media. Watch video. Close web browser. Open email. Read emails. Reply to email. Close email. Turn off laptop. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep.
